messages.content: 在柏克萊附近10公里範圍內找到一個有野餐桌和公共洗手間的自然保護區，同時在東京附近5公里範圍內找到一個有遊樂場和自行車道的自然保護區。

function.name: nature_reserve_find_nearby
function.description: Locate nearby nature reserves based on specific criteria such as amenities and proximity. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.
